title: An extra beat every minute - Nature Energy
text:
Small deviations in the power system frequency are routinely attributed to stochastic fluctuations in load and generation. New research reveals a disturbance recurring precisely every minute in grids worldwide, caused by clock-synchronized self-tests in battery-based uninterruptible power supplies that inadvertently act in unison.
